one_line: US and China form AI blocs, Anthropic faces lawsuit, AI industry sees search overhaul, financing and education initiatives.

themes.title: AI blocs split globally
themes.text: The United States and China are each building AI alliances, leaving other nations forced to choose sides.

stories.headline: Countries split as US and China create competing AI blocs

themes.title: Anthropic sued over training data
themes.text: The owners of Elvis Presley’s music have filed a copyright infringement lawsuit against Anthropic, alleging the company used 274 songs to train its AI models without permission.

stories.headline: Elvis Presley estate sues Anthropic over 274 songs, seeks $41 million

themes.title: AI industry expands with new initiatives
themes.text: Google’s AI Overviews and AI Mode have shifted search results to AI‑generated summaries, reducing traffic to news sites and paying small fees to publishers. SpaceX completed a $40 billion debt financing round to fund graphics processors for its AI compute services. The National Council of Educational Research and Training launched a 20‑hour AI and computational thinking module for classes 9‑12. Unacademy co‑founders are raising a ₹700 crore fund to back AI and deep‑tech startups.

stories.headline: Google’s AI search overhaul reduces traffic and pays tiny fees to publishers
SpaceX secures $40 billion GPU debt financing, launches AI compute contracts
NCERT releases 20-hour AI and computational thinking module for classes 9-12
Unacademy founders launch ₹700 cr AI and deeptech fund Longshot Capital
